being centered is one of the main reason that makes a model great. drive like a human - left bias < centered  driving when it comes to hands free . you get more confident when its centered. imho

But humans are centered only a very small proportion of the time. Mostly we move left and right depending on who is in the adjacent lane and according to necessity we cross the lane markings without blinking an eyelid, this is why LANELESS is the way to go.

the key here is we humans are holding the wheel so  we know we have full control vs  hands free  on left bias. Maybe its just me but i prefer CHv2 for being mostly centered or close to centered compared to other models- this is without using tricks.
